arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess,time,resource,json,os
before=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
t=time.monotonic()
with open('/app/stress.json','rb') as fi,open('/app/stress.out','wb') as fo:
 p=subprocess.run(['python3','/app/submission/main.py'],stdin=fi,stdout=fo,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,timeout=90)
after=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
print('status',p.returncode,'elapsed',time.monotonic()-t,'cpu',after.ru_utime-before.ru_utime,'maxrss KiB',after.ru_maxrss,'stderr',p.stderr[:1000])
print('input bytes',os.path.getsize('/app/stress.json'),'output bytes',os.path.getsize('/app/stress.out'))
with open('/app/stress.out') as f:d=json.load(f)
print('packets',len(d['packets']),'jobs',len(d['jobs']),'statuses',{s:sum(j['status']==s for j in d['jobs']) for s in ('applied','stale','superseded')})
PY
